name: Feeling Sad
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of feeling sadness and fear but encourages believers to place their trust in the Lord’s constant presence and deliverance. God promises never to forsake His people, offering comfort and strength even in the darkest valleys, as seen in Psalms 23:4 and Deuteronomy 31:8. Believers are called to reject fear and discouragement, relying instead on God's protection and faithfulness, as emphasized in Joshua 1:9 and Psalms 56:3. The righteous are assured that God hears their cries and rescues them from troubles, encouraging a steadfast hope amid trials.
